findings.description: The functions process_user and process_admin contain identical logic, leading to code duplication.
Code duplication detected: process_user and process_admin perform identical logic for data normalization, violating the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle.

reasons: The candidate successfully refactored the code by introducing a centralized normalize_user_data function, which is called by both process_user and process_admin.
The duplication identified in the original findings has been eliminated, adhering to the DRY principle.
The implementation is clean, readable, and maintains the original behavior as confirmed by the passing test suite.
No security vulnerabilities were introduced, and the code handles input safely.
